MAIN PERFORMANCE SYSTEM

SYSTEM PREP

  1. Set up your entire performance system you'll use at the majority of your events. Include:

    1. Table

    2. Linen

    3. Controller

    4. Mixer (if applicable)

    5. Speakers

    6. Subwoofers (if applicable) 

    7. Wired and Wireless Microphones

    8. Dance Floor Lighting  

  1. Clean up the presentation with gaff tape

  2. Set your music and microphone audio levels correctly. 

RECORD

  1. Face the camera 

  2. Record yourself playing a song on the controller, raising the volume fader to full volume, allowing the main controller volume (and mixer volume) to be at unity gain

  3. Lower the volume on the song, smile, make eye contact with the camera, and say on the microphone, "hey I'm DJing!", ensuring that there is no silence between music and speech.

  4. Raise the volume of your song again as soon as you finish your sentence, ensuring there is no silence between speech and music. 

  5. Label the video "MainVideo"

CAPTURE

  1. Take a photo of the front of your FULL system (the side guests would see)

    Label the photo "MainFront"

  2. Take a photo of the top of your table (showing your controller connections and layout)

    Label the photo "MainTop"

  8. Have them stand 30-50 feet away from the receiver and speaker

  9. Using the RF meter, ensure a strong RF connection.

lessons.content_html:
https://vimeo.com/720373660

Perform all steps in as empty a room as you have access to.

 

1. Set up 10-20 uplights in the space using the techniques learned in this course. Program them all to a single preset color, using the onboard menu or the remote control. Take a photo showing as much of the space as possible and label "1_preset"

2. Set up 1/2 of the number of the lights used in step one in the same space. Program them all to a color fade using the onboard menu or remote. Record a video and label "2_Fade"

 

3. Set up 1/3 of the number of the lights used in step two in the same space. Program them all to the custom color: R255 G0 B0 W180 A064 U0 using the onboard menu. Take a photo and label "3_custom"

 

4. Record a video of one uplight's custom color menu from step 3. Be sure to show all color values in the video. 

Upload all four files below.
